import subprocess

def generate_thumbnail(input_path, output_path, size="200x200"):
    # Resize image using ImageMagick
    cmd = f"convert {input_path} -resize {size} {output_path}"
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, check=True)

def extract_audio(video_file):
    cmd = f"ffmpeg -i {video_file} -q:a 0 -map a audio_{video_file}.mp3"
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)
